Type your secret message, tap Encrypt, and share the generated link. The recipient opens the link in the app and the message is decrypted using AES 256-bit once only. After reading, it is permanently and irrevocably deleted from the server.

All messages are encrypted with AES 256-bit a standard used by banks and governments. Encrypted data is stored only as ciphertext and deleted immediately after the first opening. No plaintext ever leaves your device.
Can I read a message more than once?
No. Messages self-destruct immediately after the first decryption and are irrevocably deleted from the server.
What happens if I lose the link?
The message cannot be recovered. There is no backup. Since the message deletes itself after opening, maximum discretion is guaranteed.
What does the Premium feature offer?
Premium users get extremely short, memorable links (only 5 dynamic digits after snote.fun/), made possible by a secure, encrypted database in the background.
Can Premium be restored after reinstallation or a reset?

No. Premium is tied to a single anonymous device token that is generated fresh on every installation. We intentionally store no personal data and cannot track devices. If the app is uninstalled, reset, or moved to a new device, Premium cannot be recovered and must be purchased again.
Messages are encrypted with AES 256-bit (bank standard). Self-destructing links guarantee that your secrets disappear forever after reading once.
